title: I called it. Part 2
note: Silent. Part 2 of Pie for Two, works for a viewer who saw no part 1: Thanksgiving eve, nearly empty all-night diner, two strangers on neighbouring stools, one last slice, both ordered it, they talk in crayon on napkins. Opener (0-3 s) is the ONLY part that differs by hook: ONE strip, two big faces, both phones lit mid-swipe (generic glow), the plate with the last slice and her napkin 'first bite?' as the bright devices, neon OPEN, clock 11:41 PM, forks move toward the plate. Context 3.0-4.5 (both raise forks: we both ordered it; adult waitress, taller and older than the customers, deadpan, never writes). Take 1 (4.5-11.0): his napkin YOU TAKE IT. / I'M FULL.; his stomach growls so loud the mugs rattle and the dispenser shakes (GRRRL scribble arc); the waitress puts a fork down in front of him. Slice wipe counter-clockwise 11.0: take 2. phones under the mugs. Close-up: phones flip face-down and mugs drop over them (plant). Take 2 (13.5-23.9): napkin ME. / I CALLED IT.; playful fork duel (forks cross, chrome spark, nobody's face near tines); she lowers her fork, napkin 'fine. go.'; he takes the bite, stops, pushes the plate back with the bigger half (music drops out); napkin HALF. / FAIR?; she laughs, they eat side by side, one shared 1 s look. Cliff: empty plate, crumbs, his mug buzzes (family text glow not readable), napkin 'why are you here / at midnight?'. Vote board by 25.8 held 5 s. End card 30.9. Never the word tip. No NoSwipe mention. Napkin inserts whole-frame ~840 px at y=760, two lines max ~18 chars.

strips.text: the stranger beside me and I are fighting over the first bite of pie.
she caught me swiping. now we're dueling over pie.
one slice left. we both ordered it.
the waitress heard it. she brought me a fork.
then I cut it in half.
I won the bite. I gave half back.
she asks why I'm at a diner on Thanksgiving eve.
